title: TrustLens Rule Evaluation Result (P3-WP1 runtime contract)
description: Phase 3 DET-001 / ADR-0005. The RUNTIME contract for the result of evaluating ONE published rule against one submission's indicator observations. Promoted and frozen from the Phase-3 design copy (docs/03-detection/contracts/) at P3-WP1; the design copy is superseded by this file. This contract fixes the SHAPE the deterministic engine (a later work package) must produce; it contains NO evaluation logic. Three-valued: required_combination_result is TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN so an UNKNOWN required indicator yields INDETERMINATE, not NOT_MATCHED (DET-001 section 7). rule_evidence_verdict, effective_severity, rule_evidence_strength and rule_detection_confidence are INDEPENDENT quantities (CONF-001). No numeric risk or probability appears anywhere. Instance references (observation ids, source ids, evidence ids) are opaque/pattern-checked, deliberately NOT JSON-Schema $refs, so the output contract stays decoupled from the knowledge schemas and API-neutral (P3-WP1 STEP 17).

sourceReference.description: Runtime-facing echo of the fired rule's evidence.source_references. A subset of the knowledge sourceReference (rule.schema.json) — enough to make the citation self-contained and auditable, not the full manual_retrieval provenance. The explanation may assert an official fact ONLY if it appears here as a quote (DET-001 explanation-provenance constraint).

evidence_class.description: ADR-0015 hierarchy of the manually-retrieved evidence layer, where present.

evaluation_state.description: MATCHED: require=TRUE and evidence-class diversity met. NOT_MATCHED: require=FALSE. INDETERMINATE: require=UNKNOWN (a decisive operand is UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS) — carries uncertainty forward (STEP 7). SUPPRESSED: matched then cancelled by an override-aware SUPPRESS_RULE. NOT_APPLICABLE: language_scope excludes the input, rule not PUBLISHED, or a per-rule evaluation error (degraded — see evaluation_error).

required_combination_result.description: Kleene three-valued evaluation of logic.require (ADR-0005). OBSERVED->TRUE; NOT_OBSERVED/NOT_APPLICABLE->FALSE; UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS->UNKNOWN.

governing.description: True if this rule is the governing rule of the decision (sets decision_severity). Aggregation/tie-break is P3-WP5; WP1 only reserves the shape.

governing_reason.description: Why this rule governs (e.g. 'highest effective severity; SUPPORTED tie-break'). Populated by P3-WP5.

neutralised_indicators.description: Positives removed by directional SUPPRESS_INDICATOR before evaluation (not override-blockable).

observation_refs.description: observation_ids (observation.schema.json instances) supporting this rule's matched operands. Instance references, not raw content (privacy, STEP 18).

indicator_observation_refs.description: Indicator-observation instance ids (indicator-observation.schema.json) this rule consumed.

evidence_classes_spanned.description: Distinct parent_evidence_class values among the TRUE operands. Size must be >= min_evidence_classes_required for a MATCH (CONF-002).

suppression.description: How suppression acted on this rule (STEP 3 suppression_effects). Semantics from negative-indicator-library-v1.json.

suppressed_by.description: Negative-indicator id or SUPPRESSION rule id that cancelled the finding, if any.

blocked_suppressors.description: Suppressors that WOULD have applied but were blocked by an active hard-risk override; recorded as explanation (FR-042).

context_only_present.description: CONTEXT_ONLY benign-context indicators recorded (never change the finding).

active_overrides.description: Hard-risk overrides active for this rule. Active only when their decisive indicators are OBSERVED at >= the extraction-confidence gate (DET-001 sections 8/10). Overrides gate suppression; they never set severity nor bypass require.

extraction_confidence_inputs.description: Per decisive indicator, the extraction confidence that fed the confidence gate. Keys are indicator ids. Never multiplied (STEP 8).

rule_evidence_verdict.description: Carried from the rule's evidence.verdict (rule.schema.json). PARTIAL/HEURISTIC cap rule_detection_confidence at MEDIUM and (via severity_cap) cap severity.

rule_evidence_strength.description: Strength of the evidence THIS rule matched on — decisive-indicator strength combined with the evidence verdict and active override. Feeds the decision-level matched_evidence_strength (ADR-0006). Distinct from rule_detection_confidence.

effective_severity.description: min(rule_severity_declared, evidence.severity_cap, any CAP_SEVERITY). Ordinal; never a number.

rule_detection_confidence.description: Per-rule detection confidence (STEP 3). NOT a probability. Aggregated at the decision level in P3-WP5.

ambiguities.description: Decisive operands that were AMBIGUOUS for this rule (e.g. payment direction unresolved).

unknowns.description: Decisive operands that were UNKNOWN for this rule.

explanation_fragment.description: Sourced from the rule's explanation object; runtime facts are interpolated, never invented (DET-001 explanation-provenance constraint).

evidence_ids.description: Manual-retrieval evidence ids behind the fired rule (evidence-records.json), where the rule relies on the manual pass.

evaluation_error.description: Present only when evaluation_state=NOT_APPLICABLE due to a per-rule error (degraded, DET-001 section 16). A single-rule error must NOT poison the whole evaluation; the decision is flagged degraded and routed to review.
